data.name: Lanvansh
data.long_meaning: Lanvansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Lan' meaning 'Lord Hanuman' and 'Vansh' meaning 'lineage' or 'blessings'. This name is a tribute to the monkey god Hanuman, who is known for his strength, courage, and loyalty. The name signifies that the child will be blessed by Lord Hanuman and will embody his qualities.
